MAGIC-EUR.summary: MAGIC has fresh venue disruption: BingX listed it on October 10, 2026, while Phemex delisted MAGIC/USDT on September 15. Combined with ongoing multi-chain migration, this can amplify short-horizon liquidity and execution risk.
materialRisks: Fresh exchange-venue churn: BingX opened MAGIC spot trading on October 10, 2026, while Phemex removed MAGIC/USDT spot on September 15, 2026; liquidity may be fragmented and unusually volatile. ([bingxservice.zendesk.com](https://bingxservice.zendesk.com/hc/es/articles/17937264821007-Treasure-MAGIC-ser%C3%A1-listada-en-BingX-Spot?utm_source=openai))

Network/asset-handling complexity remains: Coinbase directs users to migrate MAGIC to Treasure Chain, and Treasure’s bridge warns transfers across supported chains can be irreversible if mishandled. ([help.coinbase.com](https://help.coinbase.com/en/coinbase/trading-and-funding/sending-or-receiving-cryptocurrency/token-migrations?utm_source=openai))

Treasury supply-overhang authority exists: TIP-55 removed the ecosystem fund’s linear timelock and authorizes core contributors to diversify those tokens under DAO-defined market-neutral parameters; no fresh execution disclosure was found. ([forum.treasure.lol](https://forum.treasure.lol/t/tip-55-amend-linear-unlock-of-ecosystem-fund/192?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: BingX announced MAGIC/USDT deposits, trading, and withdrawals beginning October 10, 2026. ([bingxservice.zendesk.com](https://bingxservice.zendesk.com/hc/es/articles/17937264821007-Treasure-MAGIC-ser%C3%A1-listada-en-BingX-Spot?utm_source=openai))

Phemex announced delisting of the MAGIC/USDT spot pair effective September 15, 2026. ([phemex.com](https://phemex.com/announcements/phemex-will-delist-the-perp-usdt-spot-pair-100356?utm_source=openai))

Coinbase’s migration guidance identifies MAGIC as an asset to migrate to Treasure Chain via self-custody and the Treasure migration portal. ([help.coinbase.com](https://help.coinbase.com/en/coinbase/trading-and-funding/sending-or-receiving-cryptocurrency/token-migrations?utm_source=openai))
No credible fresh report of a MAGIC/Treasure exploit, protocol outage, or regulatory action was identified in the reviewed current sources.
